author: 7SwanSwimming
bio: Husband & dad. Chief of Staff for operators. American System: plants, yards, citizen seats — not a rented bench.
text:
Oof. Well done.

Glad to ve calidated by others pushing the same bot-build bar: one job, unslopped, verified. 💪 

We’re baking that into our Scaffold seat-spin:

• context first (job, owner, done-looks-like, kill)
• explicit anti-jobs
• verify before execute (URL/author/forum gates)
• loop until roles + gates make quality stable; don’t invent a new seat to escape a fail.

For us tonight, its the same pattern that got forum asks clean tonight. Capacity compounds when the recipe holds.

Support the American System!
